page.overview:
Who is Romar Adell?

Romar Adell was a human male from Serenno. Adell was, at one time, affiliated with the Confederacy of Independent Systems but eventually lost faith in Dooku, the Separatist Head of State and reigning Count of Serenno as he plundered his own people during the Clone Wars.

Following the bombardment of the planet by the Galactic Empire, Adell and other fellow Serennians went into hiding in the world's upper forest region, where he also built his domicile. He later became an ally of the Bad Batch, a group of renegade clones, who ran into trouble with the Empire on Serenno. After helping them escape a unit of stormtroopers, Adell gifted a kaleidoscope to the Batch's youngest member Omega and saw them safely off the planet.

Romar Adell first appeared in "Ruins of War," the second episode in the second season of Star Wars: The Bad Batch. He was voiced by Héctor Elizondo.
